prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: CitySim deterministic 2:1 isometric game-building visual target, non-shipping concept reference. Image 1 is only a failed framing/perspective reference; redesign the building completely while retaining the same north-facing isometric camera family and isolated single-building composition. Create a production-quality Industrial Level 4 hero foundry that looks unmistakably larger, richer, and more advanced than a Level 3 factory: a broad monumental warm-brick and weathered-steel complex centered on a huge north road-facing freight portal, with a deep readable opening, heavy portal frame, three distinct roof-height tiers, sawtooth or clerestory roof articulation, braced crane lantern, compact boiler stack, oxidized process vessel with restrained orange heat, pipe runs, vents, roof plant, loading apron, staff annex, windows, doors, railings, gutters, seams, grime, and believable material wear. Polished stylized realism for a premium top-down city-builder; materially detailed PBR-like 3D render, not photorealistic photography, voxel art, toy-like, or flat-shaded. 2:1 orthographic isometric view; the building occupies roughly 55-65% of image width and 65-75% of image height; full footprint and southeast contact shadow visible; north freight portal is the first read; no surrounding city. Bright readable late-afternoon studio daylight from northwest, warm key plus cool sky fill, controlled contrast, visible shadow detail, subtle warm windows and furnace glow; not night or underexposed. Warm red-brown brick, charcoal structural steel, weathered blue-green roof metal, oxidized machinery, concrete apron, restrained amber-orange accents. Brick courses, corrugated metal, steel beams and braces, soot and rust streaking, concrete joints, glass panes, painted safety markings; details survive downscaling. A cohesive single industrial complex; correct road-facing frontage; strong asymmetric silhouette with at least five readable breaks; no detached floating props, text, logos, people, vehicles, landscape, roads, city background, watermark, magenta, cyan-dominant planes, black background, or empty featureless walls. Avoid stacked plain boxes, huge empty canvas, darkness, generic warehouse, steampunk fantasy, sci-fi neon, mirrored facade, front-elevation view, and perspective camera.
